name: DAI Harness MCP
description: DAI Harness MCP Configuration for Antigravity

dai-harness-workspace.description: DAI Harness project intelligence with workspace isolation

notes.installation: Run 'daiharness-mcp-setup.sh setup' from your project to auto-generate this config
notes.workspace: MCP server auto-detects workspace from cwd (no ${workspaceFolder} needed — Antigravity does not resolve it)
notes.restart: Restart Antigravity after modifying this file
notes.multi_project: One config works for ALL projects with Antigravity
notes.code_intelligence: Code intelligence is provided by the DAI memory layer, registered by scripts/mcp/daiharness-mcp-setup.sh as its own dai-memory MCP server; it is not launched from here.
